# TUC-2019 — A Theme for ltx-talk

`lttalk-theme-tuc-2019` provides an unofficial TU Chemnitz presentation
theme for the `ltx-talk` class. It is built on `lttalk-themeengine` and offers the
university layout, faculty-aware colours, and an optional coordinated font
selection.

Released under the LaTeX Project Public License v1.3c or later.
See <https://www.latex-project.org/lppl.txt>.

<!-- BEGIN DEPENDENCIES (generated by tools/make-package-readmes.lua) -->
## Dependencies

Dependencies on other packages of this project and on selected third-party
packages; the usual LaTeX packages the code loads itself are not listed.

- Required at run time: `lttalk-themeengine`
- Required to build the documentation (`l3build doc`): `langselect`, `lttalk-themeengine`, `osgdoc`, `osgstyler`
- Required to run the test suite (`l3build check`): `lttalk-themeengine`, `osglecture`, `osgmodes`, `osgstyler`, `tagpax`

This package is developed in the same repository as the osglecture document class, see https://github.com/werner-matthias/osglecture, but works on its own.
